headline: Gent top but out of the cup, and only slight favourites
summary: Gent lead the Jupiler Pro League on 22 points, but they come into Sunday's home game after a 3-3 draw with third-division Rochefort ended their Belgian Cup run. Anderlecht sit fifth, 6 points back, and travel to Jagiellonia on Thursday, three days before this game. Voetbalkrant report that Anderlecht coach Vitor Bruno is fighting for his future. Across 10 bookmakers, with the margin removed, Gent are 38.1% to win against Anderlecht's 30.7%, and the handicap, a head start in goals, rates them only 0.13 goals better. The 2.5-goal line leans to the under, with over at 47%.
read: League leaders Gent, unbeaten in the league and six points clear of Anderlecht, host a side that has just gone out of the cup and whose coach is reported to be fighting for his job. The market still sees it as close: Gent are favourites at 38.1% and rated only about a quarter of a goal better, with the goals line at 2.40 suggesting a tight, low-scoring game.

facts.fact: Gent top the Jupiler Pro League with 22 points from eight games, seven wins and one draw.
facts.meaning: The league leaders host the team in fifth, with a six-point cushion over them.

facts.fact: Voetbalkrant report that Vitor Bruno is fighting for his future as Anderlecht coach, with the away trips to Jagiellonia and Gent described as decisive.
facts.meaning: Anderlecht arrive with their coach's job on the line, on the back of a cup exit.

facts.fact: Gent were knocked out of the Belgian Cup by third-division Union Rochefortoise, drawing 3-3 before going out.
facts.meaning: The league leaders come into this game off the most embarrassing result of their season.

facts.fact: Anderlecht sit fifth on 16 points from eight games, six points behind Gent.
facts.meaning: A win at Gent would pull Anderlecht right back into the title picture; a defeat leaves them trailing.

facts.fact: Anderlecht's last five read L-L-W-W-L, including a 1-2 cup defeat at Beerschot and a 0-1 loss at Dinamo Zagreb.
facts.meaning: Three defeats in five, two of them away from home in the last eight days.

facts.fact: Gent are priced 38.1% to win, against Anderlecht's 30.7%.
facts.meaning: The market makes Gent clear favourites but gives Anderlecht a live chance — this is no mismatch.

facts.fact: The market's handicap line rates Gent only about a quarter of a goal better than Anderlecht, at -0.13.
facts.meaning: Despite leading the league, Gent are not seen as dominant here — a one-goal win is roughly the expectation.

facts.fact: Gent have conceded only 0.76 expected goals per game across their last five matches.
facts.meaning: Anderlecht's attack faces a defence that is giving up very few clear chances.

sources.fact: Gent were unbeaten this season before losing to third-division Union Rochefortoise and being knocked out of the Belgian Cup in the round of 32.
Gent lead the Jupiler Pro League going into the match against Anderlecht.
Anderlecht sit fifth in the Pro League, six points behind Gent, according to Voetbalkrant.
Erik Lambrechts has been appointed as referee for the Gent-Anderlecht match on matchday nine.
Gent began their Conference League campaign with three points, which Voetbalkrant notes could prove important in their push for a top-eight finish.
Vitor Bruno said he is fully in love with football and thinks about how to improve Anderlecht even at night, adding that he was not born mauve but loves the club.
Vitor Bruno rejected the suggestion that Anderlecht are in crisis after their cup defeat at Beerschot.
Anderlecht were eliminated from the Belgian Cup by Beerschot, who won at home.
